checks.invariant: Fork or Dependabot PR code must not run with secrets or a write token
checks.result: Only pull_request/push triggers; permissions contents: read; persist-credentials: false; no secrets referenced; actions SHA-pinned.

checks.invariant: A lower-trust job must not populate a cache or artifact the release restores
checks.result: PR caches are scoped to refs/pull/N/merge; main-scope writers are main push CI and release runs only; release downloads only same-run artifacts.

checks.invariant: No PR-controlled text reaches shell or expressions
checks.result: Only github.ref (concurrency) and matrix.os expressions; no github.event.* in run scripts.

checks.invariant: Dependabot updates must not gain write or secret authority
checks.result: Weekly updates, no auto-merge; static templates.

checks.invariant: Release runs only from main by a dispatch-capable principal; downstream jobs skip when plan is skipped
checks.result: workflow_dispatch needs write access; plan gated on refs/heads/main; builds/publish need plan with implicit success().

checks.invariant: Commit/tag/branch text must not reach shell, sed/perl, GITHUB_OUTPUT or expressions
checks.result: TAG is git-cliff bumped semver from writer-created tags; passed via env; sed/perl interpolation only reachable by writers (hardening).

checks.invariant: VirusTotal response fields must not reach executable contexts
checks.result: Fields read with IFS read -r and printed with printf %s into Markdown only.

checks.invariant: Persisted contents:write credential must not reach lower-trust code
checks.result: Only SHA-pinned actions, pinned git-cliff, repo script read it; least privilege recorded as hardening.

checks.invariant: Published artifacts bound to the dispatched commit and same-run build jobs
checks.result: All jobs check out github.sha; distinct same-run artifact names; non-forced push.

checks.invariant: Release tag/version matches identity embedded in shipped binary
checks.result: Binaries built before the version bump report the previous version (v0.4.0 built from 0.3.0); no lower-trust beneficiary (hardening).

checks.invariant: All deps from crates.io with locked checksums; no git/path/patch/alt registry
checks.result: 241 crates.io packages with checksums; no git/path sources, patch, .cargo/config or submodules.

checks.invariant: Build script and toolchain inputs are not mutable or lower-trust
checks.result: build.rs only embeds in-repo resources on Windows; toolchain pinned 1.99.1; no --locked (hardening).
